d:
“Yeh Lal Rang Kab Mujhe Chhodega” is a poignant, soul-stirring track picturized on Rajesh Khanna and Hema Malini, sung by Kishore Kumar and composed by the legendary S. D. Burman with lyrics by Anand Bakshi. Reflecting the pain of love and the intoxication of heartbreak, it became one of 1974’s most unforgettable songs
Yeh Lal Rang Kab Mujhe Chhodega | Prem Nagar (1974) | Rajesh Khanna, Hema Malini | Kishore Kumar
Song : Yeh Lal Rang Kab Mujhe Chhodega
Movie: Prem Nagar (1974)
Starring: Rajesh Khanna, Hema Malini, Prem Chopra, Asrani
Singer: Kishore Kumar
Music: S.D. Burman
